subject: Proposal: LogiSys 2yr Flexible Prepay with True-up Protection
messages:
From: Anne Chen <anne.chen@logisys.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: 2-year prepay + true-up idea (LogiSys)

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo last week — LogiSys is excited about Redwood's performance profile. We're trying to finalize our procurement plan for H1 and want to propose a 2-year prepay with a couple of protections on our side:

- Target: $720k committed over 24 months (billed upfront)
- Request: 22–25% term discount off list (we were given 15% in the portal)
- Ramp protection: allow a staged usage ramp (year 1 at 60% of committed, year 2 true-up to 100%)
- True-up cap: can we cap the true-up charge in first 6 months to avoid surprise spend?

If Redwood can meet the discount + a 6-month soft true-up, we can move to purchase order immediately. I've attached our SOW and a simple forecast. Can you advise next steps and whether this needs approvals?

Anne Chen
Director, Cloud Strategy — LogiSys Corp
anne.chen@logisys.com
attachments: LogiSys-SOW-v3.pdf, pricing-model-logisys.xlsx
From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:01:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: 2-year prepay + true-up idea (LogiSys) 

Connor / Marissa — forwarding LogiSys ask. Key points: $720k upfront for 24mo, asks 22–25% off list, wants staged ramp (60% year1 -> true-up year2) and a 6-month cap on true-up.

Can we accommodate a 20% discount out of sales authority with a finance-backed true-up cap, or do we need leadership sign-off for 22%+? Also, any structure you prefer for the ramp smoothing (auto-trueup schedule vs quarterly true-ups)?

Thanks — Stephanie
Account Exec, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
From: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:17:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: 2-year prepay + true-up idea (LogiSys)

Stephanie — thanks for the summary. Quick callouts:

- Sales deck authority: you can approve up to 18% on a standard 2yr prepay. Anything above 18% requires VP approval.
- Finance carve: Marissa, can you model impact of a 6-month true-up cap (e.g., cap at 25% of the difference) and whether we can accept billed-upfront accounting?
- Legal: we'll need a short addendum for the staged-trueup terms and a one-time cap clause.

If LogiSys is ready to PO with 20% we may be able to bend if finance signs off. I'll support escalation if needed.

Connor O'Brien
Sr. Director, Enterprise Sales
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 08:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: 2-year prepay + true-up idea (LogiSys)

Team — I ran a quick model (see attached pricing-model-logisys.xlsx). Thoughts:

- 20% blended discount is acceptable if we require a quarterly true-up with a 6-month initial cap set at 30% of the deficit (this shares risk).
- Accounting note: Upfront billing recognized over the term for revenue; no booking issue.
- Exposure: If usage remains below 50% after Q1 of year1, we should include a step-down clause (credit protection) to avoid indefinite capacity drain.

Recommendation: Offer 20% discount with a staged ramp clause (60% target Y1, quarterly true-ups with a 6mo cap at 30%), include a step-down protection at month 6 if cumulative usage <50% of forecast. Legal to draft an addendum.

Marissa Cole
Manager, Revenue Ops & Pricing
attachments: pricing-model-logisys.xlsx
From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
To: Anne Chen <anne.chen@logisys.com>
Cc: connor_obrien@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, legal@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: LogiSys 2yr Flexible Prepay with True-up Protection

Hi Anne — thanks for the clear ask and the SOW. Internal guidance below; happy to walk through on a quick call if useful.

What we can offer today:
- 24-month prepay for $720,000 billed upfront
- 20% term discount off list pricing (finalized)
- Ramp smoothing: Year 1 target = 60% of committed usage, quarterly true-ups (30/60/90-day lookback)
- True-up protection: an initial 6-month cap at 30% of the difference between committed and actual usage (protects you from a single quarter spike)
- Step-down protection: if cumulative usage <50% of forecast at month 6, we will allow a one-time credit adjustment rather than immediate churn penalty (details in addendum)

Next steps:
1) If this aligns, please confirm and I'll have Legal prepare a short addendum + PO instructions.
2) We'll include the SOW as an exhibit and share a DocuSign link for signatures.

If you still need 22–25% discount, we can escalate to VP for a narrow exception but we'd need a confirmed renewal cadence or growth milestones to justify.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
attachments: none
From: Anne Chen <anne.chen@logisys.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: LogiSys RevOps <revops@logisys.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 15:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: LogiSys 2yr Flexible Prepay with True-up Protection

Stephanie — thanks, that structure works for us. We accept the 20% discount with the 6-month 30% cap and the step-down protection at month 6. Please send the addendum and PO instructions and we'll get the purchase order over next week.

Anne Chen
Director, Cloud Strategy — LogiSys Corp
